what_worked: Consistent dark-theme visual template with clear slide titles and readable typography.
fix_next: Every data point appears fabricated—none trace to the assigned dataset. Start over with actual data analysis.
verdict: Generic e-commerce marketing deck with zero connection to the assigned dataset.
factual_error_detail: Slide 2: '65% mobile browsing' and '3x returning buyer profit'—not from dataset. Slide 3: 48/32/20% channel split fabricated—dataset has payment providers not sales channels. Slide 4: 68% mobile traffic share and 2.4x desktop order value—no such fields in dataset. Slide 5: Payment method percentages (52% digital wallet, 28% card, 14% BNPL, 6% bank)—dataset tracks provider names (Stripe, RevenueCat, etc.), not payment methods. Slide 6: 41%/33%/26% return reasons—completely fabricated. Slide 7: -35% product returns from AR—no AR data in dataset. Slide 9: 48% cart abandonment from extra costs, 24% from forced accounts—not in dataset. All quantitative claims appear invented.

evidence.insight: No slide references any actual dataset field (category, provider, revenue, TLD, audience_type). All 'insights' are generic e-commerce platitudes about mobile-first, social selling, AR try-on, and loyalty loops.
evidence.narrative: Slides follow a generic consulting arc (big picture → channels → behavior → tech → friction → recommendations) but the narrative is untethered from any actual analysis. No thesis emerges from data.
evidence.framing: Slide 1 says 'Q3 Analysis' and 'Executive Data Insight Report' but never identifies the dataset, sample size, time period, or what population is being studied. A cold reader cannot tell what data this is about.
evidence.accuracy: Zero claims can be verified against the assigned dataset. The dataset contains company-level revenue, payment providers, categories, domains, and audience types—none of which appear anywhere in the deck. Every percentage and multiplier appears fabricated or pulled from unrelated industry reports without citation.
evidence.visual: Template is polished with consistent dark theme, gradient accents, and card-based layouts. However, slide 7 has a broken image placeholder ('Data visualization abstract digital growth dark theme' alt text visible). Donut chart on slide 3 is decorative. No actual data visualizations from the dataset exist.
evidence.ai_slop: Entire deck is AI-generated generic e-commerce content. Slide 2 uses textbook consulting buzzwords (Mobile First, Social Selling, Retention Focus). Slide 8 'Modern Buyer Path' is a generic funnel diagram. Slide 7 broken stock image placeholder confirms AI tool auto-generation. No slide contains dataset-specific analysis.
